name: Su-22M4 (civorodom)
summary: Free flyable Su-22M4 swing-wing fighter-bomber for DCS World, flown from the Su-25T cockpit.
description:
Adds the Su-17/Su-22M4 Fitter with bombs, rockets, Kh-25/Kh-29 and SEAD (Kh-25MP/MPU with ELINT pod). Flyable using the free Su-25T cockpit; since DCS 2.9.6 it needs the author's FC3 fix patch.

Requires: Since DCS 2.9.6 an FC3 fix patch is needed (per the file page).
